title: CETalk: Continuous Valence-Arousal Control for Audio-Driven 3D Talking Head Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.15110v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Emotional 3D talking head generation aims to synthesize expressive facial animations with accurate lip synchronization. However, existing methods often rely on discrete emotion categories, which fail to capture the continuous evolution of affect. They also overlook the temporal frequency mismatch between audio articulation and emotional expression. In this paper, we propose CETalk, an audio-driven 3D facial animation framework conditioned on continuous Valence--Arousal (VA) representations for fine-grained emotion control. CETalk predicts a sequence of FLAME parameters through three key components: a Dynamic Emotion Modulation Module that adaptively scales emotional intensity using audio-derived cues; a Multi-Scale Temporal Modeling mechanism that employs parallel branches to decouple high-frequency articulatory movements from low-frequency emotional dynamics; and a Dynamic Fusion Mechanism that integrates these multi-scale features vi

translated_title: CETalk：基于连续效价-唤醒度控制的音频驱动三维说话头生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15110v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：情感三维说话头生成旨在合成具有准确唇部同步的表情丰富面部动画。然而，现有方法通常依赖离散情感类别，这无法捕捉情感的连续演变。它们还忽略了音频发音与情感表达之间的时间频率不匹配问题。在本文中，我们提出CETalk，一种基于连续效价-唤醒度（VA）表示条件的音频驱动三维面部动画框架，用于细粒度情感控制。CETalk通过三个关键组件预测FLAME参数序列：动态情感调制模块，利用音频派生线索自适应缩放情感强度；多尺度时间建模机制，采用并行分支解耦高频发音运动与低频情感动态；以及动态融合机制，通过该机制整合这些多尺度特征。
tldr: 本文提出CETalk框架，通过连续效价-唤醒度表示和动态情感调制、多尺度时间建模及动态融合机制，解决了音频驱动三维说话头生成中离散情感分类和频率不匹配问题，实现细粒度情感控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CETalk, a framework using continuous Valence-Arousal representations with dynamic emotion modulation, multi-scale temporal modeling, and dynamic fusion mechanisms to address discrete emotion classification and frequency mismatch in audio-driven 3D talking head generation, enabling fine-grained emotion control.
